verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a SaaS secrets platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows the Events API, a pull-based REST API where consumers call endpoints like POST /api/v2/auditevents to retrieve activity for a SIEM. Nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks; polling an events API is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
